notes.title: Minor Update - Recent News Column
notes.notes:
Hello, dear air traffic controllers!

We have just carried out a minor update and added a column to the main interface of the game: Recent News.

The latest news about "Mini Airways" and CCC Games will be released here - you can also see them in the steam community news. We just integrated it into the game - such as the one you are reading now.

If you don't want to see the banner, you can click the "Recent News" button to collapse it (semi-permanently). After that, we will only let it pop up automatically once when a version update occurs to inform you of what has been updated this time.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/3bf0932310c4275194a5847534f491013e8e61bf.png"]

Meanwhile, we are very excited to announce that "Mini Airways: Premium" has officially been released on the App Store! The Google Play version is also under testing and will be available very soon.

The mobile version is priced at $4.99. The content includes:

1. 15 maps the same as those first released on the PC version and will soon catch up with the progress of the PC version

2. Level mode/Stage mode, gesture operations and automatic avoidance items optimized for the mobile version

3. The original endless mode consistent with the PC version (excluding hardcore mode, sandbox mode and map editor for now)

4. Achievements, leaderboards and cloud saves (Due to development difficulty and device differences, the mobile version will not be compatible with the PC version.)

5. Play Mini Airways: Premium on your mobile device!



Click here to purchase or pre-register immediately:

Pre-register on Google Play：

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mini.airways.paid.gp



Purchase on App Store：

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mini-airways-premium/id6478572512





Happy flying! 

CCC Games & Erabit Studios

notes.title: Patch Notes - Auto-Save, New Map, and Multiplayer In-Game Chat
notes.notes:
Dear Air Traffic Controllers, we have just performed a regular update, here are the details of the update.

[New Content]
1. Added a new map: Indianapolis International Airport (KIND), has been added. It is located in the heart of Indiana, adjacent to the world-famous Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/df74ed2dced466b3a909cdae13096587af2f78c5.png

2. Added a game save feature: When no special events occur, the game will automatically save every day (in game), and it will also save when exiting the game. 
Note: After using this feature, the game results of this session will not be counted in the leaderboard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/840f90c93a1a30d991f601123d65fbab7b500af5.png

3. Added a multiplayer chat (press the Enter key to use) and a speed adjustment quick request (automatically sent after a room guest clicks the speed adjustment function).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/963856cf63652a92186711d81ebd7024c514c8a3.jpg

4. The built-in maps in multiplayer mode can now be selected between London and Indianapolis.


Feel free to join our player community for feedback:
Official Discord: click in
Official YouTube: click in
Twitter: click in


Happy flying!
CCC Games & Erabit Studios

notes.title: Multiplayer Mode, Start! - Patch notes v0.10.2
notes.notes:
Attention all air traffic controllers, we have just released a major version update! Here are the contents of this update:

[Update Contents]
1. Support for multiplayer online gameplay.
2. That's it. (Less text, bigger news!)

[Multiplayer Gameplay Instructions]
1. We have added an initial interface entry for the multiplayer mode, which will be visible after the update.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/e00a660172205ba79f65a20e1420a73bb9a93427.png

2. After entering multiplayer mode, the game lobby will display all public online rooms and the current map being played. Players can choose to join a public room directly, enter a private room by entering the room code, or create your own room.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/d00993195bd6d4759256d346511c7d5c8d25fc06.png

3. Online rooms support Creative Workshop maps, and members who join later do not need to download the workshop map to play.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/c2ad403cfb61268ae2fa3df58cb14a3cd51ad4ae.png

4. Usually, after joining a room, you need to click the ready button, and wait host to start the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/918a243234643a05f9b50a63b485b82896f52ea5.png

5. In online mode, you can view the current room code in the lower left corner of the interface, and your teammates' mouse pointers will appear as white dots. Planes in the map can be controlled by everyone, and in-game upgrades, game speed, and pause options are all controlled by the host.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/d71c6c3e3c54bfa5366bb62cdbdb3c1e41436483.png


Official Discord: click in
Official Youtube: click in
Twitter: click in


Happy flying!
CCC Games & Erabit Studios

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.8.2 - New Map, Borderless Window, Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Air Traffic Controllers, we have just released our first update since the official game launch. In addition to adding a new map and the highly requested borderless window mode, we have also fixed several bugs reported since the game went live.

[New Content]
1. Added a new map: La Palma Airport.
2. Added a borderless window mode (Fullscreen Windowed in Options) for Windows. This mode helps prevent some issues caused by fullscreen mode.
3. Introduced Camera Offset functionality in the map editor.

[Bug Fixes]
1. Fixed an issue where the leaderboard would not refresh when switching modes.
2. Fixed an issue where the no-fly zone indicator would block the taxiing area on high-resolution screens.
3. Fixed a bug where Air Force One could collide with other aircraft off-screen.
4. Fixed issues leading to false Traffic alerts in certain scenarios.
5. Fixed an issue where scores over 999 would not display correctly.
6. Addressed other known bugs.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/5659465457526d995fe911a110c8ab9733c2aa55.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/90acf211b2e46e6c70674aa3e068cd84c8a95d17.png

notes.title: Now live: Demo version v0.1.20!
notes.notes:
Dear air traffic controllers,
A brand new demo will be free to play during the upcoming Steam Next Fest!

Here are a few highlights from the v0.1.20 update:

[olist]
 Added a ground-air separation mechanism to prevent collisions between aircraft in the air and those on the ground.
 Added a "Prevent Premature Takeoff" feature to avoid game termination due to releasing the left mouse button 0.1 seconds too early. (You can still take off aircraft very precisely).
 Added a tutorial page to review gameplay and item usage.
 Added a new style UI for the main page and map select page (we'll continue to make improvements to this).
 Reduced the gap between planes in the bottom waiting area.
 Fixed several other minor bugs.
[/olist]

Please always let us know if you encounter any issues on our Discord or Steam community so that we can fix them as soon as possible.

Enjoy managing the skies!

CCC Games

notes.title: MINI AIRWAYS DEMO Update - Steam Cloud Storage
notes.notes:
Dear air traffic controllers, the update is now live in our demo.


[New Features]

 Steam Cloud Storage: Game progress can now be synced across multiple gaming devices.
 Aircraft Status Indicator: Add indicators to show whether the aircraft have been given the specific commands.
 No Ground Air Collision Mode (For entertainment only, scores will not be uploaded) : In this mode, the aircraft in the air will not collide with the aircraft on the ground.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/e423ab1ebb0560b709cf4f3ca44acb37335acef2.jpg

 Holding Waypoint will play animation before being placed to elimate the confusion of the turning direction.


[Bugfix]

 Fixed a bug where in some cases the red warning light flashes continually after the aircraft goes around.
 Fixed some mistakes in the subtitles.
